tr: Proje gabıllı köyü arasinde 98 000 m2 alanda yerleşmiştir. Proje 2 ayrı parselden oluşuyor, projenin kurulu gücü 5 megawatt'tır. Projede 5 adet trafo merkezi, 1 adet pdl binası, 70m2 tek katlı idare etme binası yapıldı. Arazi etrafı 3200 metre telçit ile çevrildi, 1700 metre kablo kanalı kazıldı, 6016 adet panel masa direği çakıldı, 376 panel masası kuruldu, 16544 adet panel montajı yapıldı.
en: The project is located on a 98,000 m² site near the village of Gabilli. It consists of 2 separate parcels, and its installed capacity is 5 megawatts. Within the project, 5 transformer stations, 1 PDL building and a 70 m² single-storey administration building were built. The site was enclosed with 3,200 metres of wire fencing, 1,700 metres of cable channel were trenched, 6,016 panel table posts were driven, 376 panel tables were erected and 16,544 panels were installed.
